create_fbnet_classification_model: create an FBNet classification model with a specified architecture name and optional pretrained ImageNet weights
create_fbnet_backbone_model: create an FBNet backbone-only model without the classification head for feature extraction tasks
build_clsconvhead_module: build a ClsConvHead module that applies global average pooling and a 1x1 conv for classification
review_fbnetbackbone_overwrite_options: review the FBNetBackbone apply_overwrite_options method to modify stage block channels kernel size or expansion
load_fbnet_state_dict: load an FBNet pretrained state dict from a checkpoint file and strip the module prefix
